given_when_then.given: A Real-Time Inventory Snapshot shows an item with less than the configured safety margin remaining shelf life.
given_when_then.when: The Order Allocation Engine processes a new Order Request containing the item.
given_when_then.then: The system rejects the Order Request and updates the Product Catalog status to prevent new requests.

given_when_then.given: The system detects an item flagged as 'nearing expiry' in the Order Allocation Engine.
given_when_then.when: The system performs an inventory quality check on the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot.
given_when_then.then: The system updates the Product Catalog status and logs an expiry alert with a timestamp and specific item identifier.

given_when_then.given: A Store Partner queries the Product Catalog for an item flagged as 'nearing expiry'.
given_when_then.when: The system processes the query against the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot.
given_when_then.then: The system prevents the creation of new Order Requests and returns an unavailable status for the item.

success_criteria: The Product Catalog status is immediately updated upon detecting an expiry alert.
New Order Requests are rejected if the primary fulfillment source contains items flagged as 'nearing expiry'.
All expiry alerts are logged with a timestamp and the specific item identifier.
The system prevents new Order Requests for items nearing expiry based on the configured safety margin.
